name: Asa Fitch
bio: A Representative from New York; born in Groton, Conn., November 10, 1765; received a limited schooling; served in the Revolutionary War, sergeant in Captain Livingston's company; studied medicine and practiced in Duanesburg and Salem, N.Y.; justice of the peace, 1799-1810; president of the Washington County, New York, Medical Society, 1806-1826; county judge, 1810-1821; elected as a Federalist to the Twelfth Congress (March 4, 1811-March 3, 1813); declined to be a candidate for renomination to the Thirteenth Congress in 1812; resumed the practice of medicine; died on August 24, 1843, in Salem, N.Y.; interment in Evergreen Cemetery, Salem, N.Y.
